name: Stellar Incognita
source:
Stellar Incognita is a sci-fi visual novel with multiple branching paths and endings, built around the central themes of mind control and corruption.

The year is 3922 and humanity is colonizing the vast reaches of a wild and unknown space, known as the STELLAR INCOGNITA. You play the role of Sagacious-6, a nefarious and opportunistic clone worker that researches forbidden technologies for mind manipulation and corruption, in order to seek a life of indulgence and self-satisfaction. Set on a mission of revenge at the outset of the story, what fate awaits Sagacious-6 in the STELLAR INCOGNITA?​

[From F95zone]
translation:
《Stellar Incognita》是一部科幻視覺小說，擁有多條劇情分支與多種結局，以精神控制和墮落為核心主題。

時值3922年，人類正向一片浩瀚、蠻荒而未知的太空拓殖，這片區域被稱為「未知星域」。你將扮演Sagacious-6，一名陰險又善於投機的複製人勞工。為了過上縱情享樂、滿足私慾的生活，他研究著操縱心智、使人墮落的禁忌技術。故事伊始，Sagacious-6便踏上復仇之路。在未知星域中，等待他的會是怎樣的命運？

[摘自F95zone]
